recovery_source: task-notification event delivered synchronously by the harness to the dispatching worker session for this exact agent_id, received and read before the next row was dispatched. Independent re-verification via the recorded output_file path was attempted for all 8 agent_ids and found EMPTY (0 bytes) for every one -- see G2D-RECOVERY-AR1312.md. This recovery artifact therefore rests on a single retrieval path, not two independent ones; that limitation is disclosed, not hidden.
